record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:76 — P2/conf75: duplicate Attendee rows — dedupe uses case-sensitive `guest === attendee.email` and never dedupes within `guests` itself (server schema at addGuests.schema.ts:5 is `z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness; the refine exists only client-side), and there is no (bookingId,email) unique constraint, so `John@x.com` vs existing `john@x.com`, a repeated email in one payload, or two concurrent requests each insert duplicate attendee rows for the same person.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed with `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`, which is case-sensitive, so `John@x.com` won’t be treated as already-present `john@x.com`. It also does not dedupe within the `guests` payload itself (filter checks only against existing attendees + blacklist), while the server schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` is just `z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness constraint. As a result, a payload containing the same email twice can lead to duplicate `attendees.createMany` inserts.
